properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 19 at 6:39AM EST until November 19 at 9:45AM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
FFWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Brevard County in east central Florida...

* Until 945 AM EST.

* At 639 AM EST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Palm Bay, Melbourne, Malabar, Indialantic, Barefoot Bay, Roseland,
West Melbourne, Melbourne Beach, Grant-Valkaria, Micco, Melbourne
Shores, Floridana Beach, Spessard Holland Park, Melbourne Airport
and Eau Gallie.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

NWSheadline: FLASH FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 1145 AM EST THIS MORNING FOR SOUTHEASTERN BREVARD COUNTY
CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 11:45 AM EST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 11:45 AM EST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.
